description: MISUMI 5 series T-slot and OpenBuilds V-slot rails, with slot nuts. Place fixed-length components on points, or build independent rails along straight sketch lines.
name: Extrusions

end_taps.description: Tap every bore of the chosen end M5, 12 mm deep. Start is the placement point for fixed-length rails, or the source line’s start for sketch-driven rails.
end_taps.title: Tapped ends

hole_face.description: The face the screws go in from, for the holes that name none: +Y and -Y are the two ends of the section's height, +X and -X of its width. A face with two slots gets a hole in each.
hole_face.title: Holes from

holes.description: Optional M5 screw-hole distances in mm, such as 10, 290. Measured from Start, or the chosen endpoint in Sketch driven mode. Each cuts a 9.5 mm access hole and a 5.5 mm clearance hole. A face name applies to following distances: +X 10, 290 -Y 150.
holes.title: Screw holes

holes_from.description: Sketch driven only: measure screw-hole distances from this end of each path line. The offsets follow later length changes.
holes_from.title: Hole distances from

length.description: Fixed length only. Sketch-driven rails take their lengths from the path lines.
length.title: Length

mode.description: Fixed length places shared components on points. Sketch driven creates an independent rail on each chosen straight sketch line; edit the path to change the rails.
mode.title: Mode

path_lines.description: Sketch driven only: comma-separated line ids, such as l1, l2. With a named sketch and no ids, uses all its drawn straight lines. Otherwise select lines in one sketch. Up to 16 rails per run; machining may require smaller batches.
path_lines.title: Path lines

size.description: Width and height in tens of millimetres: 2040 is 20 mm along the sketch X and 40 mm along Y. A V-slot comes as 2020 to 2080.
size.title: Size

sketch.description: Fixed length: placement sketch. Sketch driven: the sketch containing the path lines; leave empty to use selected straight lines from one sketch.
sketch.title: Sketch

sketch_point.description: Fixed length only. Point or circle ids in the placement sketch, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection. Leave empty in Sketch driven mode.
sketch_point.title: Sketch point

slot.description: T-slot is the MISUMI 5 series rail (HFS5, NFS5) with a 6 mm slot. V-slot is the OpenBuilds rail, whose slot faces are chamfered for wheels.
slot.title: Slot

thread_modeled.description: Cut actual threads instead of cosmetic threads. Sketch-driven runs allow at most four modeled taps across all rails.
thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread

along.description: The sketch axis the rail runs along, so the nut lies along the slot.
along.title: Rail runs along

size.description: The thread the nut is tapped with.
size.title: Size

sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.
sketch.title: Sketch

sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, on the rail's face in the middle of a slot, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.
sketch_point.title: Sketch point

slot.description: The rail the nut sits in. The nut hangs under the lips, 2 mm below the face of a T-slot and 1.8 mm below the face of a V-slot.
slot.title: Slot

thread_modeled.description: On cuts the thread into the hole. Off drills the tap hole and lists the thread.
thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread

type.description: Pre-assembly is MISUMI HNTT5, 10 mm long, which slides in from the end of the rail. Post-assembly is MISUMI HNTP5, 17 mm long, which goes in through the slot and has a spring ball under it.
type.title: Type
